rationale: CoA — coenzyme pool; per-cell needed from pantothenate
FADH2 — reduced redox state; never the demand (see riboflavin)
L-carnitine — small pool for FA transport, per-cell accumulating
NADH — reduced redox state; net accumulating pool is NAD+ from niacin
NADPH — reduced redox state; net accumulating pool is NADP+ from niacin
riboflavin — vitamin, feeds flavin pool (FMN/FAD synthesis)
ubiquinol — reduced redox state; ETC turnover, not accumulating demand
